zeroVarianceConvention: Original deterministic convention retained: a zero-variance paired log contrast uses point intervals; p=1 for exactly zero contrast, p=0 for nonzero contrast. These finite-input results do not establish population certainty.
scope: Eight fixed main conditions N128, short trajectories after initial disjoint block/unblock; callbacks are batch-mode main-loop diagnostics, not displayed frame or interaction latency.

m1.effectOrientation: first algorithm divided by second algorithm; lower is better

multiplicity.tests: Holm step-down adjusted p-values across six unordered algorithm pairs
multiplicity.decisionIntervals: Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals across the same six pairs

m2.effectOrientation: first algorithm divided by second algorithm; lower is better

multiplicity.tests: Holm step-down adjusted p-values across six unordered algorithm pairs
multiplicity.decisionIntervals: Bonferroni simultaneous 95% intervals across the same six pairs

decision.basis: The preregistered M1/M2 evidence did not uniquely select one eligible algorithm without forcing a ranking.
